proposals.evidence: Full bīja explicitly gives Nepali biu seed, Kumaoni bĩyo/biyõ and regional bīa/bīyā seed. These directly support Majhi/Bote bʸu seed as a glide-bearing reduced regional form. Source superscript glide and vowel notation remain intact; local phonetic history and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. The separately compounded bījadhāna/bījadhānya seed-corn entries were inspected and are not substituted.
